reason: I'd probably start the free 14-day trial since there's no auto-charge, but paying is another story. I already play free sleep sounds on YouTube, and on my budget I'm cutting subscriptions, not adding one for a fade-out timer.
objection: Will the phone-on-the-bed tracking really show I fall asleep faster, or will the difference be a few minutes that could just be random because my bedtime changes every week anyway?
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fell asleep 10+ minutes faster on the SLEEP:ON nights, I'd pay the yearly 39,000 won.
